purpose: Matched AH+PM loss comparison and validation-selected optimizer comparison; user-facing results in chat
losses: MSE; twice Huber with delta=1 percentage point; twice pseudo-Huber with delta=1 percentage point, matching small-error MSE curvature
learning_rate_selection: For each optimizer and annual fold, select one rate using the mean best prior-year validation MSE over fixed pilot seeds 7 and 19. Use it for all ten seeds in that fold. No test labels, portfolio returns or ranking metrics enter selection; ties within 1e-7 choose lower LR.
optimizer_semantics: AdamW default beta=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, decoupled weight decay. RAdam same beta/eps and decoupled_weight_decay=true. SGD uses momentum=0.9, dampening=0, nesterov=false, standard coupled weight decay. Identical numeric decay coefficients do not imply identical regularization across these optimizer families.
checkpoint_rule: Common prior-year raw-return MSE early stopping for all losses; earliest improvement exceeding 1e-7. This isolates the training objective while keeping the prior stopping rule. Constant LR, no warmup or schedules, deterministic FP32, chronological batches, no shuffle.
architecture: Exactly the saved parent ExtendedModel: original five-channel THINK+mixer core plus bounded shared 320-to-16-to-1 AH+PM correction, all jointly trained from matched random initializations. Same data, masks, folds, train-only normalization and graphs.
parent_controls: Reuse all 40 parent AdamW/MSE/LR=0.001 fits; retrain the 2025 seed-7 control once to verify the new trainer reproduces its epoch and forecasts before new recipes run.
fit_budget: Up to 240 new candidate fits plus one parity-control fit; 40 parent controls reused. Optimizer pilot grid has 72 cells, eight reused. Selected LR candidates reuse pilot/parent fits wherever available. Fixed robust-loss recipes require 80 fits. No extension based on test outcomes.
failures: Stop and disclose nonfinite loss/gradient failures. If a prior finite checkpoint exists, retain that checkpoint and mark numerical termination; candidates without a finite validation checkpoint are ineligible. If an optimizer has no valid LR for any fold, report its policy unavailable rather than replace it using test performance.
portfolios: 174 accounts: six recipes x three fixed seed groups x two holding counts x three fee multipliers (108); six recipes x ten individual seeds at top-ten/base fees (60); SPY/QQQ x three fees (6). Top-ten is primary; top-five secondary. Same 09:15 ET feature cutoff, 09:20 decision, regular-close entry, five-session holding cycle, $1m continuous NAV, fees and ADV constraints.
inference: 10000 paired circular-block replicates at 5/20/60 sessions, 20 primary. Primary fixed ten-seed family has 20 active-return contrasts: six recipes versus SPY/QQQ (12), five new policies versus fixed MSE (5), tuned RAdam and SGD versus tuned AdamW (2), pseudo-Huber versus Huber (1). Original/new-five families are separate diagnostics. Absolute SR and paired SR differences also disclosed.
stop_rule: Pass objective/optimizer tests, freeze sources/data/protocol, verify parent parity, complete and hash-lock every planned pilot and selected fit before new test financial or ranking metrics. Reproduce selected checkpoint exports and independently replay every account. Do not select a test winner for deployment.
limitations: Previously inspected 2022-2025 exploratory development. This is not a full loss-by-optimizer factorial or an exhaustive optimizer/budget/schedule search. No claim of universally best optimizer. No new documents, spreadsheet changes, trades or scheduled jobs requested.
